t: Forge Steel tin snips set provides essential cutting tools for various sheet metal applications. The reliable 3-piece kit contains 250mm snips for left, right, and straight cuts, making it ideal for professional use in ductwork, roofing, and general fabrication tasks. Each tin snip features drop-forged and heat-treated carbon steel jaws, ensuring precise and durable performance when working with thin metals. Ergonomic soft-grip PVC handles offer comfortable and secure handling during extended use on site or in the workshop.
b: Includes Left, Right & Straight Cut Snips
